{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CemYueeYbpfsRvtzmDWsL","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01SkU9KnyE96iin9QBFjYNse","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20260901-162328/nbody_claude-sonnet-5-cc-medium_mpi_r3/nbody/nbody.cpp","content":"#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;\nconstexpr double DT = 0.01;\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\n\nstruct Body {\n    Vec3 pos;\n    Vec3 vel;\n};\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Compute forces for the local range [localStart, localStart + localCount) of\n// bodies, using the globally replicated position array `globalPos`, and\n// update the corresponding local velocities in place.\nvoid computeForces(const std::vector<Vec3>& globalPos, std::vector<Vec3>& localVel,\n                    int localStart, int localCount) {\n    const size_t n = globalPos.size();\n\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(localStart + li);\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = globalPos[j].x - globalPos[i].x;\n            const double dy = globalPos[j].y - globalPos[i].y;\n            const double dz = globalPos[j].z - globalPos[i].z;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n\n        localVel[li].x += DT * Fx;\n        localVel[li].y += DT * Fy;\n        localVel[li].z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n// Integrate the local range of bodies in place, updating the corresponding\n// segment of the (globally replicated) position array using local velocities.\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Vec3>& globalPos, const std::vector<Vec3>& localVel,\n                      int localStart, int localCount) {\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        Vec3& pos = globalPos[static_cast<size_t>(localStart + li)];\n        pos.x += localVel[li].x * DT;\n        pos.y += localVel[li].y * DT;\n        pos.z += localVel[li].z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\n// Compute the total energy (kinetic + potential) across all ranks. Each rank\n// contributes the kinetic energy of its local bodies and the potential energy\n// of pairs (i, j) with i in the local range and j > i; the partial sums are\n// then reduced across all ranks so every process is left with the same total.\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Vec3>& globalPos, const std::vector<Vec3>& localVel,\n                           int localStart, int localCount, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    double localEnergy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = globalPos.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass) for locally owned bodies\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        const Vec3& vel = localVel[li];\n        localEnergy += 0.5 * (vel.x * vel.x + vel.y * vel.y + vel.z * vel.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies), partitioned by i\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(localStart + li);\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = globalPos[j].x - globalPos[i].x;\n            const double dy = globalPos[j].y - globalPos[i].y;\n            const double dz = globalPos[j].z - globalPos[i].z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            localEnergy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    double totalEnergy = 0.0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, comm);\n    return totalEnergy;\n}\n\n// Validate that the locally owned bodies produce finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulationLocal(const std::vector<Vec3>& globalPos, const std::vector<Vec3>& localVel,\n                              int localStart, int localCount) {\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        const Vec3& pos = globalPos[static_cast<size_t>(localStart + li)];\n        const Vec3& vel = localVel[li];\n\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(pos.x) || !std::isfinite(pos.y) || !std::isfinite(pos.z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(vel.x) || !std::isfinite(vel.y) || !std::isfinite(vel.z)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(pos.z) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(vel.z) > maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;\nconstexpr double DT = 0.01;\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n        \n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n            \n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        \n        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;\n        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;\n        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;\n        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;\n        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n    \n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + \n                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y + \n                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n    \n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        \n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n    printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Initialize bodies\n    std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies);\n    randomizeBodies(bodies);\n    \n    // Run simulation\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        computeForces(bodies);\n        integrateBodies(bodies);\n    }\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        // Serialize body positions and velocities for hashing\n        std::vector<double> bodyData;\n        bodyData.reserve(numBodies * 6);\n        for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.x);\n            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.y);\n            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.z);\n            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.x);\n finite, reasonable values\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating simulation results...\\n\");\n        \n        if (validateSimulation(bodies)) {\n            // Report final energy for li < localCount; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(localStart + li);\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n\n        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;\n        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;\n        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n// Integrate the local range of bodies in place (only the locally owned\n// bodies' positions are updated).\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, int localStart, int localCount) {\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        Body& body = bodies[static_cast<size_t>(localStart + li)];\n        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;\n        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;\n        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\n// Compute the total energy (kinetic + potential) across all ranks. Each rank\n// contributes the kinetic energy of its local bodies and the potential energy\n// of pairs (i, j) with i in the local range and j > i; the partial sums are\n// then reduced across all ranks so every process ends up with the same total.\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies, int localStart, int localCount, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    double localEnergy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass) for locally owned bodies\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        const Body& body = bodies[static_cast<size_t>(localStart + li)];\n        localEnergy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + body.vel.y * body.vel.y + body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies), partitioned by i\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(localStart + li);\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            localEnergy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    double totalEnergy = 0.0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, comm);\n    return totalEnergy;\n}\n\n// Validate that the locally owned bodies produce finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulationLocal(const std::vector<Body>& bodies, int localStart, int localCount) {\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        const Body& body = }"]}],"originalFile":"#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;\nconstexpr double DT = 0.01;\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\n\nstruct Body {\n    Vec3 pos;\n    Vec3 vel;\n};\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Compute forces for the local range [localStart, localStart + localCount) of\n// bodies, using the globally replicated position array `globalPos`, and\n// update the corresponding local velocities in place.\nvoid computeForces(const std::vector<Vec3>& globalPos, std::vector<Vec3>& localVel,\n                    int localStart, int localCount) {\n    const size_t n = globalPos.size();\n\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(localStart + li);\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = globalPos[j].x - globalPos[i].x;\n            const double dy = globalPos[j].y - globalPos[i].y;\n            const double dz = globalPos[j].z - globalPos[i].z;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n\n        localVel[li].x += DT * Fx;\n        localVel[li].y += DT * Fy;\n        localVel[li].z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n// Integrate the local range of bodies in place, updating the corresponding\n// segment of the (globally replicated) position array using local velocities.\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Vec3>& globalPos, const std::vector<Vec3>& localVel,\n                      int localStart, int localCount) {\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        Vec3& pos = globalPos[static_cast<size_t>(localStart + li)];\n        pos.x += localVel[li].x * DT;\n        pos.y += localVel[li].y * DT;\n        pos.z += localVel[li].z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\n// Compute the total energy (kinetic + potential) across all ranks. Each rank\n// contributes the kinetic energy of its local bodies and the potential energy\n// of pairs (i, j) with i in the local range and j > i; the partial sums are\n// then reduced across all ranks so every process is left with the same total.\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Vec3>& globalPos, const std::vector<Vec3>& localVel,\n                           int localStart, int localCount, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    double localEnergy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = globalPos.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass) for locally owned bodies\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        const Vec3& vel = localVel[li];\n        localEnergy += 0.5 * (vel.x * vel.x + vel.y * vel.y + vel.z * vel.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies), partitioned by i\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(localStart + li);\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = globalPos[j].x - globalPos[i].x;\n            const double dy = globalPos[j].y - globalPos[i].y;\n            const double dz = globalPos[j].z - globalPos[i].z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            localEnergy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    double totalEnergy = 0.0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&localEnergy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, comm);\n    return totalEnergy;\n}\n\n// Validate that the locally owned bodies produce finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulationLocal(const std::vector<Vec3>& globalPos, const std::vector<Vec3>& localVel,\n                              int localStart, int localCount) {\n    for (int li = 0; li < localCount; ++li) {\n        const Vec3& pos = globalPos[static_cast<size_t>(localStart + li)];\n        const Vec3& vel = localVel[li];\n\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(pos.x) || !std::isfinite(pos.y) || !std::isfinite(pos.z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(vel.x) || !std::isfinite(vel.y) || !std::isfinite(vel.z)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(pos.z) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(vel.z) > maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Compute a block distribution of `numBodies` across `numRanks` ranks,\n// filling in per-rank counts and displacements (in number of bodies).\nvoid computeDistribution(int numBodies, int numRanks, std::vector<int>& counts, std::vector<int>& displs) {\n    counts.resize(numRanks);\n    displs.resize(numRanks);\n    const int base = numBodies / numRanks;\n    const int rem = numBodies % numRanks;\n    int offset = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < numRanks; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0);\n        displs[r] = offset;\n        offset += counts[r];\n    }\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0, worldSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);\n\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n        printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Determine this rank's slice of the bodies (block distribution)\n    std::vector<int> counts, displs;\n    computeDistribution(numBodies, worldSize, counts, displs);\n    const int localStart = displs[rank];\n    const int localCount = counts[rank];\n\n    // Initialize bodies identically to the serial version: generate the full\n    // set on rank 0, then broadcast positions (needed by every rank for force\n    // computation) and scatter velocities (owned locally by each rank).\n    std::vector<Vec3> globalPos(numBodies);\n    std::vector<Vec3> localVel(localCount);\n    {\n        std::vector<Vec3> fullVel;\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies);\n            randomizeBodies(bodies);\n            fullVel.resize(numBodies);\n            for (int i = 0; i < numBodies; ++i) {\n                globalPos[i] = bodies[i].pos;\n                fullVel[i] = bodies[i].vel;\n            }\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(globalPos.data(), numBodies * 3, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        std::vector<int> velCounts(worldSize), velDispls(worldSize);\n        for (int r = 0; r < worldSize; ++r) {\n            velCounts[r] = counts[r] * 3;\n            velDispls[r] = displs[r] * 3;\n        }\n        MPI_Scatterv(rank == 0 ? fullVel.data() : nullptr, velCounts.data(), velDispls.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                     localVel.data(), localCount * 3, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    // Precompute allgatherv parameters (in units of doubles: 3 per body)\n    std::vector<int> posCounts(worldSize), posDispls(worldSize);\n    for (int r = 0; r < worldSize; ++r) {\n        posCounts[r] = counts[r] * 3;\n        posDispls[r] = displs[r] * 3;\n    }\n\n    // Run simulation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        computeForces(globalPos, localVel, localStart, localCount);\n        integrateBodies(globalPos, localVel, localStart, localCount);\n\n        // Synchronize the updated positions across all ranks\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DOUBLE,\n                        globalPos.data(), posCounts.data(), posDispls.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                        MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<Vec3> fullVel;\n        if (rank == 0) fullVel.resize(numBodies);\n\n        std::vector<int> velCounts(worldSize), velDispls(worldSize);\n        for (int r = 0; r < worldSize; ++r) {\n            velCounts[r] = counts[r] * 3;\n            velDispls[r] = displs[r] * 3;\n        }\n        MPI_Gatherv(localVel.data(), localCount * 3, MPI_DOUBLE,\n                    rank == 0 ? fullVel.data() : nullptr, velCounts.data(), velDispls.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                    0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            // Serialize body positions and velocities for hashing\n            std::vector<double> bodyData;\n            bodyData.reserve(numBodies * 6);\n            for (int i = 0; i < numBodies; ++i) {\n                bodyData.push_back(globalPos[i].x);\n                bodyData.push_back(globalPos[i].y);\n                bodyData.push_back(globalPos[i].z);\n                bodyData.push_back(fullVel[i].x);\n                bodyData.push_back(fullVel[i].y);\n                bodyData.push_back(fullVel[i].z);\n            }\n            print_results(bodyData, \"Bodies\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Validation: check that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (validate) {\n        if (rank == 0) printf(\"Validating simulation results...\\n\");\n\n        const bool localValid = validateSimulationLocal(globalPos, localVel, localStart, localCount);\n        int localValidInt = localValid ? 1 : 0;\n        int allValidInt = 0;\n        MPI_Allreduce(&localValidInt, &allValidInt, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_LAND, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (allValidInt) {\n            // Report final energy for reference\n            double finalEnergy = computeTotalEnergy(globalPos, localVel, localStart, localCount, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Final energy: %.6f\\n\", finalEnergy);\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            }\n            exitCode = 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            exitCode = 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return exitCode;\n}\n","userModified":false}}
